يعتكدون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَكِدُونَ (yaʕtakidūna) /jaʕ.ta.ki.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# يُعْتَكَدُونَ (yuʕtakadūna) /juʕ.ta.ka.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
